title: Video Capture
text: Capture video from input video device and send to algorithm, 1 input, 1 output, {Image size} sets Image size; {Image size ([width, height])} sets the image size, {Pixel format} sets the format of the pixel and {Sample time}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: msg
ports.summary: Data message from video capture interface scalar

ports.name: Color
ports.summary: Color component of image height -by- width matrix

params.name: Image size ([width, height])
params.values: Image size [320, 240] (default) | 2 -element vector of positive integers

params.name: Pixel format
params.values: Format of the pixel data RGB (default) | YCbCr 4:2:2

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Sample time in seconds -1 (default) | positive scalar
